Nice Family Restaurant Now
Jun 2022
Si, Lam, and I just got to Ha Giang today and was looking for a little Western food before we go off into the mountains for the next few days and this was where we wound up. We ordered a pizza, fried rice, and some sort of beef dish and everything was very good though nothing to write home about. It is a nice looking place run by a good family with two young children. Evidently this was a popular drinking establishment for foreigners before the pandemic. Vietnam is open again, but things are not the same and certainly international tourists are still not fully back. This place looks like it is hanging on still geared to foreigners and not Vietnamese customers like many places changed to because of COVID. I hope they are able to be a popular again one day. Like I said, the food is good and also they seem to have a good variety of liquor.
